title: Stork Airlift: Momentum Transfer Lab
description: A Ferrari sits on a frictionless ice track while a stork flies overhead carrying cargo crates. The user must orchestrate a sequence of crate drops from the stork onto the Ferrari's roof, managing momentum conservation and kinetic energy budgets to guide the car into a target zone. An undo/redo system lets the user revise drop sequences to achieve the precise final velocity.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load ferrari.glb placed on a flat reflective ice plane at origin and stork.glb flying 8 units above. Scene has HDR-style lighting: a directional light simulating sun, ambient light, and a subtle fog. Camera starts at a 45-degree elevated angle looking at the Ferrari.

Physics simulation (custom, no library): The Ferrari slides frictionlessly along the X-axis. The stork flies a looping path above the track carrying 6 colored crates (simple box meshes attached below it). A HUD shows: Ferrari mass, current velocity, total momentum, kinetic energy, and a target velocity zone (green band on a velocity gauge).

Interaction steps: (1) Click a crate on the stork to select it. (2) Use a slider to set the stork's X-position for the drop point. (3) Use a second slider to set the crate's mass (1-5 kg). (4) Press DROP button to release the crate; it falls with gravity and collides perfectly inelastically with the Ferrari, transferring momentum via conservation law p_total = (m_car + m_crates)*v_new. (5) After each drop, the Ferrari's velocity updates and it visually slides along the track. (6) A momentum bar and energy bar update in real time. (7) Repeat drops with remaining crates to reach the target velocity band. (8) Implement Undo button that reverses the last drop, restoring previous mass and velocity state. (9) Implement Redo button to reapply undone drops. (10) A VERIFY button checks if the Ferrari's velocity is within the target zone and shows success/fail overlay.

The stork should have a gentle wing-flap animation using sinusoidal rotation on wing bones if available, otherwise bob vertically. Crates glow on hover. Show trajectory preview line when a crate is selected. Track has distance markers. Display a running history log panel of all drops with mass, delta-v, and cumulative momentum. Use pastel UI with semi-transparent panels.
